rework_history.reason: Acceptance review CSET-203-R002 (review 2, rework round 2 of 2) found AC-3 (new-behavior) not proved: recoverInterruptedRun runs after getPackages(cwd), so the CLI reads package files before looking for the journal. A run killed mid-write that leaves a package.json truncated or invalid makes version fail before recovery. No test covers this order.. Reproduce: Create a project with a valid journal whose files entry holds the original pkg-a package.json bytes. Overwrite packages/pkg-a/package.json with invalid JSON, such as '{ "name": "pkg-a", "ver'. Run version({cwd}). Expect it to restore the file, warn 'interrupted', remove the journal, and finish with pkg-a at 1.1.0 and the changeset consumed. Today getPackages throws first.. AC-3: a focused failing test for exactly this first, proved by the red gate on the current code, then the production fix.
